notes_for_editor: Thin record. The register gives the design, condition, elevation and registration. No build date, builder, staffing, fire history or access rules were found in two searches and about five page reads. The USGS well record USGS-291414082560985 is named DOF-CEDAR KEY TOWER (ROSEWOOD TOWER) and sits about 57 m from the register's coordinates (29.237940, -82.935888 vs 29.2374648, -82.9356754, our calculation); it is cited in the story as a possible same-site lead, not a confirmed identity, and the register itself does not mention Rosewood or DOF. The 'Suwannee' in the register name is unexplained. Search hits that were not used: an 80 ft LS-40 in Colfax, New York (not Florida); a 1801 Cedar Key watchtower (not a lookout); the Dunnellon ranger station. height_m 24.4 is the register's 80 ft converted; cab-floor height not stated. The brief's elevation_m 6.1 matches the register's 20 ft site elevation, not tower height.
